Synopsis:
A rapidly spreading wildfire (Hawk fire) in Reno, Nevada exceeded 13,000 acres, forcing ~42,000 residents to evacuate and placing an additional 45,000 under evacuation warning. Strong winds, low humidity and dry vegetation drove the blaze toward the University of Nevada campus. ~10,000 homes and businesses lost power, key roads were closed, and a state of emergency was declared. The event is primarily a local US emergency management story with no direct energy market angle.
